incumbent_yggdrasil_r11.evidence: 280/280 source-only conventional parity; existing fixed front/carry cue learner; no original-world use

incumbent_yggdrasil_r12.evidence: 120/120 conventional choice parity; no original-world use

rationale.nr_m2f: Full-public exact-match count was tied 84/84 by independently trained conventional count.
rationale.nr_m2g: Full-public copy/constant effect cells tied 84/84 by independent fitted structural control; 149 source fields (147 pixel scalar values plus heading and mission), not initial incorrectly stated 443.
rationale.exposed_exploratory: Action-5 front-cell conditional effect check was authored and examined after NR-M2G. It is forever excluded from blind cohorts.
rationale.distinct_target: Learn which of the 149 source-public before components condition selected action outcomes rather than relying on a hardcoded front/carry cue (R11) or a constant per-action overwrite (M2G). Explicitly test intervention-family transfer, retention and usefulness for selected action decisions where feasible.

legal.inputs: Exact original public image 7x7x3, direction 0..3, source-admitted mission; exact selected action IDs 0..6; only committed selected before/action/returned-after.
legal.forbidden: Hidden positions, world/seed or fixture-family ID, episode name, frozen CHECK outcomes, unselected action outcomes, privileged carrying, reward oracle, future returns, hardcoded front-cell/door/key answer, R7 8-bit/3-action projection.
legal.original_world: NO original Farama/MiniGrid reset/step, cohort consumption, FSA witness, native source mutation or protected promotion. Research Charter #857 is advisory. FSA #83 remains open, is not a permit.
legal.native_separation: No mutation, import or wholesale copy of Yggdrasil R11/R12. Authenticate pinned original source when available; run R11 as an incumbent only through separately authorized source-only qualification and compatible output metrics.

hypotheses.candidate: Bounded source-public action-conditioned local predictive effect cells select compact before-state predicates from actual selected feedback. Their state grows and revises under contradictory outcomes, preserving uncertainty and cold restart; they must not rely on manually preselected source cue positions.
hypotheses.null: Fully trained conventional decision tree, Bayesian/conditional-count and feature-factorized model using identical selected feedback and public source values matches or outperforms the candidate; R11's existing native cue model also matches on applicable comparable output channels.
hypotheses.no_shortcut: Improvement over full-state count or R11 fixed cue alone cannot demonstrate scientific architectural novelty when a fully fitted conventional feature learner ties.

fixture.designation: ARTIFICIAL DEVELOPMENT SOURCE ONLY, not independently owned interactive source
fixture.separate_from_all_prior_fixture: Exclude old M2F exact-state dataset, M2G copy/constant dataset, R11 door/carry demo, and exploratory action-5 front-cell contrast from FIT/VAL/CHECK as blind scientific evaluation.
fixture.generator_contract: Define all synthetic FIT/VAL/CHECK generators in immutable test source before executing any CHECK queries; use a fixed documented Python standard-library integer PRNG per cohort, with every input validated by pinned nr_m2e_extended_public.full_public. No real environment actions.
fixture.independent_cohorts: FIT/VAL/CHECK distinct seeds and independently formed nuisance public frames; complete/check source SHA readback before first evaluation. CHECK never used for architecture decisions or parameter selection.

families.fit: action-specific public-state-conditioned local scalar changes with deliberately varied unrelated pixels and direction, spanning at least 2 distinct precondition values per relevant branch; synthetic public transition source independent of candidate implementation.
families.val: different nuisance correlations and publicly visible mission/orientation combinations under learned FIT conditional rule, for one bounded model/hyperparameter selection before CHECK.
families.check_a: fresh nuisance and public composition distribution, source-applicable same conditional transition relation; label as same-mechanism novel-context, NOT unfamiliar causal physics.
families.check_b: new structural conditional relation not observed in FIT; require uncertainty/abstention and separate transfer score (zero-shot errors must not be relabeled as scientific wins); only lawful subsequent FIT updates may improve it.

fixture.action_budget: At most 128 selected before/action/after feedback events per original action, 896 in total including every attempted valid selection; disclose exact per-cohort use. At most 5 forecast steps. Distinguish chosen action outcome from generated unselected counterfactual oracle.
fixture.fit_minimum: Prespecify min 4 selected samples per candidate conditional branch; no prediction on insufficient or contradictory support. No threshold tuning on CHECK.
fixture.negative_probes: Wrong-action, unreturned-action, duplicate-feedback, schema/private-field, wrong mission, unseen cue, conflicting outcome, resampled nuisance and cross-action distractor must cause refusal or calibrated uncertainty.
fixture.holdout_rule: No model features, decision thresholds, random seeds or fixture rules may change after CHECK results become visible; any correction restarts prospectively on new unseen cohorts and old results remain negative.

mandatory: Exact-public fully trained categorical count with same selected sample history and 7-action identity

R11 immutable native fixed cue learner or independently labelled source-faithful reference with bounded applicability and equal public right; never claim execution of Yggdrasil native model when not verified
Independently fitted Bayesian/count predictor choosing public feature predicates on FIT/VAL, not hardcoded to front-cell or target
Independently fitted CART-style depth-2 decision tree over full public before features and selected action with same FIT/VAL and model complexity declared
Equally fitted recurrent/state-space public transition learner when independently executable under the same legal source-only resource contract; else report COMPARISON_INCOMPLETE
No-memory, no-action, action-shuffled and context-shuffled ablations, under same resources
independent_controls.fairness: Match source-visible features, selected action order, fit evidence, VAL selection rights, CHECK exposure, hardware, total CPU/RSS and checkpoint bytes. Compare strongest qualified conventional rather than weakest.
independent_controls.incompatible_outputs: R11 predicts public effect categories, not full public pixel frames: score equivalent observable change categories and abstention, never mis-score absent exact-frame API as failure.

decision.primary: Report CHECK-a supported/correct/incorrect/abstained and CHECK-b zero-shot correctness separately, then strongest fitted control same task and budget. Report action-dependent return/useful decision if the source-only task legitimately measures it.
decision.strict_negative: Tie, worse-than-strongest, no effective transfer, or benefit solely from artificial shortcut = NO UNIQUE ADVANTAGE; preserve failures and nulls.
decision.qualification: All existing mandatory original R10/R18/MG19 source custody and candidate-focused dual-OS tests, affected-interface tests, mandatory full FORGE Linux/Windows regression on exact final head; immutable per-arm provenance. No focused-cache reuse without exact content key.
decision.claim_boundary: Passing these source-authored engineering fixtures proves only source-only mechanism operation, not actual unfamiliar-world learning, first-use admission, native model integration, autonomy, or promotion.

authority.changes_allowed: Additive files and existing research workflow in current draft FORGE PR #1267; no competing PR/controller/runner; no protected merge or accepted ref
